description: Recover annual overhead and owner compensation across billable hours. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

compensation.description: Annual owner compensation target. Owner-chosen annual pre-tax compensation target, separate from additional business profit. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

hours.description: Annual billable hours. Calendar working weeks × productive hours/week × explicit billable share. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

overhead.description: Annual overhead. Use matching records or a clearly identified owner assumption for annual overhead, in the displayed unit and the stated row/period scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

profit.description: Annual additional profit target. Explicit owner-supplied assumption for annual additional profit target. Label it as a scenario and compare alternatives; do not present it as a forecast. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_service_business_hourly_rate
